human_authoring.title_zh: Codex harness engineering for agent workflows
human_authoring.summary_zh: This local replay digest captures a reusable Codex harness pattern for long running agent workflows, including eval coverage, sandbox permissions, tool-use checks, context handling, and observability gates.
key_ideas: Harness engineering turns long-running agent behavior into a repeatable workflow contract.
Agent workflow evals should cover tool calls, sandbox permissions, and recovery paths.
Context handling and observability need to be checked before production rollout.
practice_checklist: Bind each agent workflow to eval cases and permission checks.
Track tool failures, context drift, and recovery paths in the harness.

human_authoring.title_zh: Claude safety evals and tool-use system card
human_authoring.summary_zh: This local replay digest summarizes Claude model release context with reusable safety eval, containment, deployment constraint, tool-use permission, and observability practices for production agents.
key_ideas: Model release context should connect benchmark evals to capability and safety boundaries.
Tool-use permissions and deployment constraints need explicit release documentation.
Regression checks and observability help turn safety notes into operational practice.
practice_checklist: Review eval coverage alongside deployment constraints before launch.
Document tool permissions, containment assumptions, and monitoring signals.
